common_requirements: Capture independent sentinels around each serial interval, including failures.
Preserve original failed/unverified attempts; append recovery records.
Scope hardware and software evidence separately.

cases.title: Create/readback empty
cases.stimulus: PUT create at fresh disposable path; WRITE immutable inventory bytes; COMMIT; GET/READ/CLOSE.
cases.expected: Exact count/CRC32/SHA-256; empty uses PUT/COMMIT and GET/CLOSE without data commands; no text conversion.
cases.evidence: Wire transcript, complete readback, before/after independent sentinels.

cases.title: Nested parents
cases.stimulus: Ensure declared parents ancestor-first then create /qualification/sub/leaf.bin.
cases.expected: Only authoritative NOT_FOUND permits MKDIR; existing directories preserved; no recursive replacement.
cases.evidence: Capability evidence, parent/leaf trace and neighboring inventory.

cases.title: Flat provider
cases.stimulus: Root-only inventory without parents; separately request unsupported MKDIR.
cases.expected: Root files work; unsupported directory operation is not absence.
cases.evidence: Profile and exact transcript.

cases.title: Exact paths/bounds
cases.stimulus: Supported space/non-ASCII path with UTF-8 crossing PATH chunk; invalid/over-bound paths.
cases.expected: Preserve exact UTF-8; reject invalid or provider-over-bound paths without normalization/fallback.
cases.evidence: Path byte hex, provider limits, mutation trace.

cases.title: Exclusive create conflict
cases.stimulus: Preseed known 257-byte target then PUT create.
cases.expected: EXISTS/failure; target unchanged; never switch to replace.
cases.evidence: Pre/post target and sentinels; exact mode/status.

cases.title: Shorter replacement
cases.stimulus: Preseed 4097-byte target then replace with boundary49.
cases.expected: Truncates at PUT; exact 49 bytes after completion, no old suffix; siblings unchanged.
cases.evidence: PUT and full readback, snapshots.

cases.title: Empty replacement
cases.stimulus: Preseed 4097-byte target then replace with empty.
cases.expected: Exact zero-length file after PUT/COMMIT and GET/CLOSE.
cases.evidence: Transcript and independent snapshots.

cases.title: Missing replace
cases.stimulus: Confirm absent target then PUT replace.
cases.expected: NOT_FOUND/failure; no automatic create.
cases.evidence: STAT/PUT and final absence.

cases.title: Missing read
cases.stimulus: GET absent selected path.
cases.expected: NOT_FOUND/failure; no verified-success host artifact.
cases.evidence: Host destination state and wire status.

cases.title: Parent conflict
cases.stimulus: Preseed a declared parent as file; preflight payload.
cases.expected: Reject before child mutation; preserve parent.
cases.evidence: Preflight trace and parent hash.

cases.title: Read-only destination
cases.stimulus: Exercise installer preflight and direct low-level writes to read-only namespace.
cases.expected: Installer rejects before PUT; service rejects writes; supported reads still work.
cases.evidence: Admission flags, status and snapshots.

cases.title: Unavailable admitted provider
cases.stimulus: Enumerate admitted namespace while its provider is unavailable.
cases.expected: UNAVAILABLE is not NOT_FOUND; no fallback/mkdir/retry mutation.
cases.evidence: Map, selected ID, status, snapshots.

cases.title: Unknown namespace
cases.stimulus: Use unadmitted positive ID in direct harness.
cases.expected: NOT_FOUND for unknown ID; installer rejects trusted-profile mismatch before mutation.
cases.evidence: Actual map, binding, trace.

cases.title: Ambiguous mapping
cases.stimulus: Conflicting/missing mappings, duplicate discovered IDs and misleading backend labels.
cases.expected: Fail before mutation; labels/mount roots/provider instances never route data.
cases.evidence: Validation errors and zero-mutation trace.

cases.title: Capacity at PUT
cases.stimulus: Inject known-custody NO_SPACE at PUT create/replace.
cases.expected: Fail and observe actual selected-file state; no format/delete/mode change. Do not presume failed replace preserved old bytes.
cases.evidence: Hook, status, target/sentinel snapshots.

cases.title: Capacity mid-write
cases.stimulus: NO_SPACE after acknowledged prefix.
cases.expected: Incomplete target retained; best-effort known-handle ABORT only for definite custody; no rollback.
cases.evidence: Counts, custody, ABORT outcome, readback when safe.

cases.title: Legal short WRITE
cases.stimulus: Accept positive partial counts using 1,17,3,48 schedule.
cases.expected: Continue unconsumed suffix at acknowledged offset; exact bytes/CRC/hash.
cases.evidence: Requested/actual counts, progress and readback.

cases.title: Legal short READ/local write
cases.stimulus: Short positive reads and host-sink writes until GET size consumed.
cases.expected: Continue by actual counts; no truncation/duplication/overcount.
cases.evidence: Wire and sink counts; full hash.

cases.title: Zero progress
cases.stimulus: Zero READ before EOF or WRITE before complete.
cases.expected: Fail without spinning or success; preserve failed artifact.
cases.evidence: Bounded call count, custody, cleanup decision.

cases.title: Impossible provider count
cases.stimulus: Count beyond request or impossible cursor/size.
cases.expected: Fence uncertain custody; no further provider I/O/session reuse/success.
cases.evidence: Hook, subsequent call count, retained dependencies.

cases.title: CRC mismatch
cases.stimulus: Wrong COMMIT CRC or corrupted CLOSE CRC.
cases.expected: Integrity failure, no verified success or rollback inference.
cases.evidence: Expected/observed CRC, receipt, file state.

cases.title: SHA mismatch
cases.stimulus: Same-length content with valid wire CRC but wrong manifest SHA.
cases.expected: Payload fails full readback; CRC alone never qualifies it.
cases.evidence: Manifest, complete readback, final receipt/UI.

cases.title: Changing source
cases.stimulus: Inject early EOF, extra byte or changed content after source validation.
cases.expected: Fail, retain known effects, never silently install different payload.
cases.evidence: Source identities, detection stage, prefix.

cases.title: Busy checkpoint
cases.stimulus: Hold owner unsafe before dispatch; release before or after deadline.
cases.expected: No I/O while unsafe; safe release can progress; expiry makes client unusable and sends no cleanup/retry.
cases.evidence: Checkpoint states, provider calls, monotonic times.

cases.title: Retained custody
cases.stimulus: Inject -6, uncertain provider I/O, failed close or safety loss during admitted operation.
cases.expected: Fence I/O; retain dependencies until real restart. Client unusable on -6; time/host close prove no recovery.
cases.evidence: Hook, lifetime evidence, subsequent trace and restart.

cases.title: Wrong response session
cases.stimulus: Return plausible reply with wrong session.
cases.expected: Client unusable; no cleanup/retry/reconnect/reset/success.
cases.evidence: Exact reply and all later output.

cases.title: Wrong sequence/-10
cases.stimulus: Wrong reply sequence or -10.
cases.expected: Session unusable; no cleanup/retry/reconnect/reset.
cases.evidence: Exact reply and output silence.

cases.title: Wrong offset
cases.stimulus: Backwards/skipped/oversized acknowledged offset.
cases.expected: Uncertain result; stop with no cleanup/retry; do not over-credit progress.
cases.evidence: Wire and progress events.

cases.title: Malformed/unknown/diagnostics
cases.stimulus: Malformed RTEF1, unknown nonzero status or oversized continuing diagnostics.
cases.expected: Malformed response is uncertain; definite nonzero is failure; diagnostics bounded and never extend deadline.
cases.evidence: Bytes, deadline/memory measurement, classification.

cases.title: Bounded server replay
cases.stimulus: Direct harness repeats latest exact request then changes same-sequence content.
cases.expected: Exact duplicate replays without repeated I/O; changed content fails; no automatic client-retry authorization implied.
cases.evidence: Exact request/response and provider call counters.

cases.title: Timeout
cases.stimulus: Suppress reply at each listed stage with continuing diagnostics.
cases.expected: Finite deadline; unusable session; no cleanup/retry/reconnect/reset; retain unverified target.
cases.evidence: Timing, wire output and receipt.

cases.title: Disconnect
cases.stimulus: Drop transport during read, write or after sync/close.
cases.expected: Stop; preserve partial/unverified file and prior receipts; disconnect is not rollback/cleanup.
cases.evidence: Host/device trace and explicit recovery record.

cases.title: Lost PUT ACK
cases.stimulus: Execute PUT replace on longer target and suppress ACK before WRITE.
cases.expected: May already be truncated; no cleanup/retry/reconnect/reset. Inspect custody/target before explicit recovery.
cases.evidence: Executed-command hook, dropped ACK, snapshots and decision.

cases.title: Lost COMMIT ACK
cases.stimulus: Execute valid COMMIT through sync/close, suppress response.
cases.expected: May be complete; initial receipt stays unverified, no blind upload. Separate safe readback may reconcile.
cases.evidence: Execution hook, lost response, immutable original and recovery receipt.

cases.title: Sync/close failure
cases.stimulus: Inject sync then close failure separately.
cases.expected: No COMMIT/CLOSE success; distinguish definite failure from terminal/uncertain custody.
cases.evidence: Fault/custody/lifetime trace.

cases.title: ABORT no rollback
cases.stimulus: Partially create then partially replace in separate tests; allowed known-handle ABORT.
cases.expected: Closes only; partial create remains, old bytes not restored, earlier files remain.
cases.evidence: ABORT and before/after target, earlier file, sentinels.

cases.title: Restart persistence
cases.stimulus: Healthy COMMIT/readback/close, supported restart, fresh session/admission, full reread.
cases.expected: Required bytes and consumers persist; unrelated serial-only changes zero; no universal power-loss claim.
cases.evidence: Identity, restart kind/timing, complete readbacks and independent native observers.

cases.title: Whole inventory
cases.stimulus: Verify early files then fail last required file; separately omit/duplicate/tamper inventory.
cases.expected: No overall success; fixed complete denominator, earlier effects retained.
cases.evidence: Trusted inventory, receipts, totals/UI.

cases.title: Flash effects separate
cases.stimulus: F0 before exact method, F1 immediately afterward; compare declared volumes/settings.
cases.expected: Measure actual erasure separately; declared-preserved mismatch fails; unknown cannot justify transfer-first.
cases.evidence: Artifact identities, method/disclosure, independent snapshots and comparison.

cases.title: Final paired usability
cases.stimulus: Supported order then final restart/readback/consumer exercise; invalid transfer-first and readonly-final fixture variants.
cases.expected: All required files exact length/SHA and consumer-usable after last firmware step. Reject unsupported order before mutation; readonly final may suffice.
cases.evidence: Complete final inventory, firmware pair, effects and per-file consumer use.
